description: A PNG image of one diagram frame, or of the whole page, to check your work by eye. Needs a live editor (the user clicks "Connect agent").

documentId.description: File-mode document id from openflow_open or openflow_create; omit to use the paired editor (or, in file mode, the document opened or created last).

frameId.description: Diagram frame id, from create_diagram or list_diagrams; omit for the whole page.

pageId.description: Page to act on (see list_pages); defaults to the page the editor shows, or the first page in file mode.

name: screenshot
title: Screenshot a diagram
